# Procedure API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Something done to a subject, such as a surgery, an implant or an injection, with fields that depend on its type.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedure/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/procedure/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `procedure` (detail, create, update), `procedures` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `subject` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [Procedure type](/api/schemas/procedure/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Schema payload:** `coordinates_system` selects a [Coordinates type](/api/schemas/coordinates/); send its fields in `coordinates_details`. `coordinates_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`materialusage`](/api/modules/materialusage/), [`procedurelog`](/api/modules/procedurelog/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `type` | one of the [Procedure types](/api/schemas/procedure/) **[required]** |
| `status` | one of `planned`, `performed`, `cancelled` **[required]**. Planned: prepared but nothing has happened yet. Performed: this record describes what was done. Cancelled: planned and then dropped; kept for the record. |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `subject` | [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `procedure_episode` | [`procedureepisode`](/api/modules/procedureepisode/) id; nullable. Perioperative episode this procedure belongs to. |
| `performed_by` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id; nullable. Person who physically performed this procedure (may differ from the record creator). |
| `date_time` | datetime; nullable |
| `licenses` | list of [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) ids. Licenses authorizing this specific procedure |
| `protocol` | [`protocol`](/api/personal_attributes/protocol/) id; nullable |
| `equipment` | list of [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/) ids |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `target_regions` | list of [`anatomicalregion`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/) ids; nestable |
| `coordinates_system` | one of the [Coordinates types](/api/schemas/coordinates/) **[required]** |
| `coordinates_details` | JSON object |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]**. Schema version for type_json field |
| `coordinates_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]**. Schema version for coordinates_json field |
| `anatomical_reference` | [`anatomicalreference`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/) id; nullable |
| `coordinate_transform` | [`coordinatetransform`](/api/taxonomies/coordinatetransform/) id; nullable |
| `materials` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `stages` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedure/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('procedure', load_all=True)
records = resp['procedures']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('procedure', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.procedures;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedure/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('procedure', data={"type": "Anesthesia", "status": "performed", "subject": "<subject-id>", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}, "coordinates_system": "Stereotaxic_BregmaBrainSurface", "coordinates_details": {"...": "the fields of the selected Coordinates type"}})
record = resp.json()['procedure']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('type', 'Anesthesia', 'status', 'performed', 'subject', '<subject-id>', 'details', struct(), 'coordinates_system', 'Stereotaxic_BregmaBrainSurface', 'coordinates_details', struct()), 'procedure');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.procedure;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedure/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('procedure', id='<id>', data={"notes": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'notes', 'new value'), 'procedure', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedure/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('procedure', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'procedure');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `apply_material_template` | POST `/api/private/modules/procedure/<id>/apply-material-template/` |
| `coordinate_context_options` | GET `/api/private/modules/procedure/coordinate-context-options/` |
| `coordinate_preview` | POST `/api/private/modules/procedure/coordinate-preview/` |
| `saved_coordinate_preview` | GET `/api/private/modules/procedure/<id>/coordinate-preview/` |
| `material_options` | GET `/api/private/modules/procedure/material-options/` |
| `materials` | GET, PUT `/api/private/modules/procedure/<id>/materials/` |

`materials` returns the ordered material usage rows of the procedure; `PUT` replaces them as a whole (a stale list is refused with 409). `apply-material-template` copies the rows of a material usage template onto the procedure. `material-options` lists the material roles and allowed sources of a procedure type (`?type=<Type>`). `coordinate-preview` renders the saved or posted coordinates in the atlas of the subject's species.

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Procedure data model page](/datamodel/modules/procedure/).
